title: The Cubs win the 2016 World Series — 108 years and a goat later
sources: Wikipedia: 2016 World Series — the Cubs defeated the Cleveland Indians in seven games to win their first World Series since 1908, ending the longest championship drought in North American professional sports; their first World Series since 1945; the two teams had a combined 176 seasons without a title; Game 7 went to extra innings and was the first Game 7 with a rain delay, as the 10th inning was about to start; Ben Zobrist's go-ahead double and Miguel Montero's RBI single gave the Cubs the cushion for an 8–7 win; Zobrist was World Series MVP; Game 7 had over 40 million viewers; the Cubs came back from a 3–1 series deficit (the Cavaliers 'also' did so in 2016)

Wikipedia: Curse of the Billy Goat — during Game 4 of the 1945 World Series at Wrigley Field, William Sianis's pet goat Murphy was bothering fans and the pair were asked to leave; Sianis allegedly declared 'Them Cubs, they ain't gonna win no more'; the Cubs did not play in another World Series for 71 years
Also on this day (candidates.md, in the app): 1959 the first section of Britain's M1 motorway opens; 2000 Expedition 1, the first crew, arrives at the International Space Station
Photos (public domain / CC0): the 2016 World Series (Cubs vs Indians); the Cubs at the White House, 2017; Wrigley Field panorama; the 1906 and 1913 Cubs; Joe Tinker and Mordecai Brown tobacco cards
Illustrative stock footage (Pexels, free licence; not of the event): a baseball diamond from the air, fireworks

post.facebook:
On this night in 2016, the Chicago Cubs won the World Series — their first title since 1908.

For generations, fans blamed a goat. During Game 4 of the 1945 World Series at Wrigley Field, tavern owner William Sianis's pet goat, Murphy, was bothering fans, and the pair were asked to leave. Sianis is said to have declared: "Them Cubs, they ain't gonna win no more." The Cubs did not reach another World Series for 71 years.

In 2016 they did — and fell behind Cleveland three games to one. They fought back to a Game 7, which went to extra innings, and then became the first Game 7 ever stopped by rain. After the delay, Ben Zobrist hit the go-ahead double and the Cubs won 8–7.

More than 40 million people watched the longest championship drought in North American sports come to an end.

Also on 2 November: Britain's first motorway, the M1, opened (1959), and the first crew moved into the International Space Station (2000).

The Cubs waited 108 years. Our app is much closer than that — follow the page and be in the stands when it lands. 📜

youtube.description:
2 November 2016: the Chicago Cubs won the World Series for the first time since 1908. Fans had blamed the Curse of the Billy Goat: in 1945 William Sianis and his goat Murphy were asked to leave Wrigley Field, and the Cubs didn't reach another World Series for 71 years. In 2016 they fell behind Cleveland 3–1, forced Game 7, went to extra innings — and then it rained. After the delay, Ben Zobrist's double won it 8–7, in front of more than 40 million viewers.

Also on 2 November: the M1 motorway opens (1959) and the first ISS crew arrives (2000).
